root.label: Cross-border yen borrowing reaches record in March 2026

events.label: Cross-border yen borrowing reaches record in March 2026

slots.name: yen borrowing amount
slots.sentence: Cross-border yen borrowing — a proxy for the carry trade — ballooned to a record 360 trillion yen ($2.35 trillion) as of March, according to a Jefferies analysis of data from the Bank for International Settlements, making it the largest carry-trade build-up of the past three decades.
